The '''International Congress on Industrial and Applied Mathematics (ICIAM)''' is an international congress in the field of [[applied mathematics]] held every four years under the auspices of the [[International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]]. The initial proposal for this conference series was made by [[Gene Golub]].<ref>{{citation|title=Obituary: Gene H. Golub (1932–2007)|journal=[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]|volume=450|page=962|year=2007|doi=10.1038/450962a|first=Lloyd N.|last=Trefethen|pmid=18075573|issue=7172|doi-access=free}}.</ref>

==List of congresses==
* ICIAM 1987 &ndash; {{Flagicon|France}} [[Paris]]
* ICIAM 1991 &ndash; {{Flagicon|United States}}[[Washington, D.C.]]
* ICIAM 1995 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Germany}}[[Hamburg]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20071008144559/http://www.uni-regensburg.de/Fakultaeten/nat_Fak_I/Mennicken/CICIAM.html]
* ICIAM 1999 &ndash; {{Flagicon|United Kingdom}}[[Edinburgh]] [http://www.ma.hw.ac.uk/iciam99/] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160918133745/http://www.ma.hw.ac.uk/iciam99/ |date=2016-09-18 }}
* ICIAM 2003 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Australia}}[[Sydney]] [http://www.iciam.org/event/iciam-2003-sydney]
* ICIAM 2007 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Switzerland}}[[Zurich]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20050401233310/http://www.iciam07.ch/]
* ICIAM 2011 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Canada}}[[Vancouver]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20181230030413/http://www.iciam2011.com/]
* ICIAM 2015 &ndash; {{Flagicon|China}}[[Beijing]] [http://www.iciam2015.cn/] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201021032207/http://www.iciam2015.cn/ |date=2020-10-21 }}
* ICIAM 2019 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Spain}}[[Valencia]] [http://www.iciam.org/event/iciam-2019-valencia]
* ICIAM 2023 &ndash; {{Flagicon|Japan}}[[Tokyo]] [http://www.iciam.org/event/iciam-2023-%E2%80%93-tokyo]
